title: security: rbac-v2 KMS region pinning + audit logging hardening
author: Maya Chen
release_notes: Harden RBAC v2 constraints for KMS region pinning and make audit logging stricter. No breaking changes for existing configs; opt-in strict enforcement behind feature flag.
description:
Motivation: Customers in regulated environments require strong guarantees that KMS keys and encrypted data remain in region-bound residency and that RBAC policies cannot be used to bypass region constraints. This PR hardens RBAC v2 enforcement for KMS region pinning and increases audit logging fidelity for all credential and KMS-related policy decisions.

What this PR does: - Adds enforcement checks to RBAC v2 evaluation to validate KMS region residency when policies reference key ARNs or key aliases. Policies that attempt cross-region key references will be rejected during apply when strict residency enforcement is enabled. - Emits detailed audit events for KMS-related policy decisions, including resolved key metadata (key_id, region, account, alias) and the policy rule that evaluated the decision. Audit events are annotated with request_id and route context. - Introduces a feature flag (rbac_v2.kms_residency_enforce) with three modes: off (existing behavior), audit (log but allow), enforce (reject on violation). Default remains "audit" for a safe rollout. - Adds migration helpers and diagnostics to detect resources that would be impacted by switching to enforce mode. - Updates the private installer to surface region residency warnings during plan/apply and adds a remediation script for moving keys/policies where feasible.

Backwards compatibility and rollout: Default behavior preserves existing functionality by keeping the flag in "audit" mode. Customers can opt-in to "enforce" after reviewing diagnostic reports. The PR includes a CLI check and a Console diagnostic report under Security -> Key Management -> Residency.

Testing and verification: - Unit tests for RBAC evaluator and KMS metadata resolver. - Integration test that simulates cross-region key ref and asserts audit event produced in audit sink. - E2E upgrade test across a small Dedicated cluster ensuring no policy regressions.

Related: ENG-3214 (RBAC v2 residency design), SEC-112 (KMS compliance requirements), SUP-789 (customer support case for cross-region KMS leakage).

notes_for_ops: To migrate to enforce mode: 1) run redwoodctl diagnostics kms-residency --export=csv and review sample remediation_plan.csv 2) remediate or rekey cross-region keys, or create regional aliases 3) enable rbac_v2.kms_residency_enforce=on and monitor audit sink for rejects. Rollback: set feature flag back to audit.
